concept_continuity.preserved_metaphor: One physical input activates exactly one of four co-located circuits; adjacency does not imply bundled permission.
concept_continuity.preserved_action: Stationary reach, one deliberate press, hand withdrawal, and a calm final hold.
concept_continuity.preserved_camera_rule: One locked portrait-format take with no camera motion or reframing.
concept_continuity.material_change: The complete body, wardrobe, pose, practical lights, switch, room, light, shadow, lens perspective, and composition are authored together in one newly generated full-scene keyframe.
concept_continuity.forbidden_parent_mechanism: A007 or any prior portrait/video frame may not be used as a start frame, background, edit target, crop, cutout, plate, or compositing source.

owner_rejection_binding.resolved_failure: No portrait-to-scene assembly: the accepted keyframe must look photographed as one coherent world.

root_lock_binding.retained_thesis: Continuity of movement, discontinuity of rights.
root_lock_binding.declared_child_divergence: The root ivory-and-gold wardrobe is superseded for this child only; the four-circuit causal metaphor remains the M03-to-M04 continuity axis.

outfit_lock.name: Midnight Petrol Column
outfit_lock.editorial_intent: Quiet authority with architectural precision; visibly new, contemporary, and neither bureaucratic nor resort-coded.
outfit_lock.silhouette: A full-length midnight-petrol tailored jumpsuit: close, clean asymmetric bodice; one sculptural folded shoulder; defined natural waist; long fluid wide legs with a single pressed crease and no train.
outfit_lock.materials: Matte satin-backed crepe with soft weight and almost no specular glare; narrow antique-brass waist bar; no sequins, embroidery, logos, prints, ivory panels, or blouse construction.
outfit_lock.color: Deep petrol blue-green, near-black in shadow but chromatically distinct from the warm mineral room.
accessories: one slim brushed-brass cuff on the non-switch wrist
outfit_lock.shoes: Black matte leather square-toe ankle boots with a low architectural block heel; both shoes visible and planted naturally.
outfit_lock.hair: Long brown hair with the A007 hairline preserved, clean center part, drawn into a low polished ponytail down the back; no fringe or loose strand crosses the eyes, cheeks, or jaw.
outfit_lock.makeup: Natural warm skin, restrained complexion, subtle eyeliner, neutral lip; no editorial face paint or glossy highlight that changes facial geometry.
outfit_lock.fit_and_motion: Tailoring remains stable during the reach; only physically plausible low-amplitude fabric settling at elbow and trouser hem, never used as the narrative effect.
outfit_lock.continuity_rule: Silhouette, seams, color, hardware, accessories, boots, and hair remain unchanged across the keyframe and all animation frames.

full_scene_lock.environment: A newly authored monolithic mineral-plaster lighting chamber, warm limestone-grey with a shallow smoked-brass reveal and a dark honed-stone floor; no office, counter, resort, temple, beach, government setting, or recognizable location.
full_scene_lock.four_circuit_motif: Four ordinary frosted-glass architectural wall lights form a clean vertical register beside Zantara. Each has its own discreet physical circuit; all are initially dark. One unlabelled smoked-brass push switch sits at her hand height.
full_scene_lock.initial_state: All four practical lights are visibly off; soft directional key light models Zantara independently so her identity and outfit remain readable.
full_scene_lock.final_state: After one press, only the second light from the bottom emits one stable neutral pool. The other three remain unambiguously dark.
full_scene_lock.composition: Native 9:16 head-to-boot tableau. Zantara occupies the left-central safe column; the complete outfit and both boots are visible. Switch and all four lights occupy the right-central plane without overlaps, edge clipping, or tiny unreadable scale.
full_scene_lock.coherence_rule: Body, clothing, contact shadows, switch, fixtures, floor reflections, wall perspective, and key light must agree as one exposure from one camera; no pasted edges, halo, scale mismatch, conflicting vanishing points, or portrait-card look.
full_scene_lock.physicality_rule: The room and practicals are real materials photographed cinematically, not CGI, a product render, collage, split screen, diagram, interface, or hologram.

camera_light_lock.capture: Native portrait 9:16, 720x1280 delivery, 24 fps animation, eight seconds, one continuous take.
camera_light_lock.camera: Rigid tripod, camera height 1.25 metres, level horizon, zero pan, tilt, dolly, crane, orbit, zoom, roll, breathing, stabilization float, or digital reframing.
camera_light_lock.lens: Natural 50 mm-equivalent rectilinear lens, approximately four metres from subject; fixed focus and exposure; no wide-angle stretch or telephoto flattening.
camera_light_lock.perspective: Zantara, switch, and vertical light register share a credible architectural plane; hands reach laterally without forced perspective.
camera_light_lock.base_light: Large soft key from camera-left at approximately 4200 K, restrained warm wall bounce, subtle negative fill camera-right, no beauty-ring catchlight.
camera_light_lock.circuit_light: The activated practical is neutral 4800 K, localized and stable, with plausible falloff; it does not relight or reshape the face dramatically.
camera_light_lock.exposure: Protect warm skin and petrol fabric detail; no clipped practical, crushed outfit, teal-orange grade, bloom, flare, or synthetic glow.

acceptance_gates.composition: PASS only if an independent reviewer finds a single coherent photographic scene with no cutout, seam, halo, perspective conflict, portrait-card framing, border, or reused background.
acceptance_gates.outfit: PASS only if the complete Midnight Petrol Column lock, both boots, accessories, and hair are visible, materially plausible, unchanged, and cleanly separated from the background.
acceptance_gates.identity: Exactly one face; ArcFace cosine against A007 must be at least 0.60 on the keyframe, with independent holistic identity PASS and no face obstruction.
acceptance_gates.metaphor: All four physical practicals and the one unlabelled switch must be readable in the initial keyframe; animation must activate exactly one practical while three remain dark.
acceptance_gates.camera_and_materials: Lens perspective, body scale, floor contact, switch reach, light direction, and shadows must agree; no CGI or compositing cues.
acceptance_gates.text_and_ui: Zero visible text, symbols, numerals, signage, labels, logos, captions, borders, UI, or technical overlays.
acceptance_gates.video_identity: Five sampled animation frames; ArcFace average at least 0.60 and every frame at least 0.55; exactly one face; fail closed.
acceptance_gates.video_continuity: No camera movement, morph, cut, transition, light-count change, wardrobe change, hair change, hand mutation, or environment drift.
acceptance_gates.audio: Native audio may contain only quiet room air and one soft dry synchronized brass-switch click; no speech, music, hum, bass bed, or unrelated ambience.

originality_and_provenance.reason: This design lane creates no media and does not claim a new conceptual metaphor; any execution lineage must bind this exact child-lock hash and the eventual accepted keyframe hash before animation.
